context: Felix is an animal. All animals are living things.
question: Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Felix is living.
raw_logic_programs:
Premises:
Animal(felix) ::: Felix is an animal.
forall x (Animal(x) -> Living(x)) ::: All animals are living things.
Conclusion:
Living(felix) ::: Felix is living.

context: Tom is a cat. All cats are animals.
question: Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Tom is not an animal.
raw_logic_programs:
Premises:
Cat(tom) ::: Tom is a cat.
forall x (Cat(x) -> Animal(x)) ::: All cats are animals.
Conclusion:
